text:
sam: FYI: customer reported double billing when a websocket client stalls during a streaming response and then reconnects. Appears both the resumed session and the stale session get charged for the same tokens.
li: which tenant/route? do we have the session id or trace link?
sam: tenant=orbit-ops, route=/v1/stream/chat (ws), session=0f9b3c. Trace: https://kibana.internal/redwood/trace/0f9b3c. Two charge events ~4s apart.
maya: interesting, this smells like the "tombstone window" we discussed: proxy invalidates lease but ack processing from the backend arrives late.
kevin: if ledger applied the delayed ack after the new session resumed, we'd see duplicate token deltas. We need a dedupe strategy.
nora: quick log snippet I pulled from ingest and ledger:
```
[I] 2026-03-22T09:03:11Z proxy conn drop session=0f9b3c reason=idle
[I] 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z client reconnect new_session=1c7d8a resume_token=tok-217
[I] 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z billing charge tenant=orbit-ops chunk=217 tokens=94 session=1c7d8a
[I] 2026-03-22T09:03:15Z ledger apply_ack session=0f9b3c chunk=217 tokens=94
```
li: so ledger applied the older ack after billing already charged for the resumed session. order-of-operations race.
sam: UX impact is badcustomers see double cost spikes and open billing tickets. Console shows two near-identical events.
kevin: implementation options: (A) make ledger charging idempotent by tracking charged_chunk_ids per tenant with short TTL, (B) add an atomic check at write time: if chunk already charged, ignore and emit reconciliation event, (C) push logic to proxy to wait for final ack before leasing new session (risky for latency).
nora: (A)/(B) look safest long-term. We'll need to guarantee bounded memory for the charged set and shard it. Also need tests for concurrent writers.
maya: short-term mitigation: have proxy add header `x-resume-hint: chunk=217` on reconnect so console can mark the subsequent charge as suspicious and not immediately bill in UI. Low-risk and fast.
li: I can add a console badge and a dashboard panel that counts "charges that collided with active resumes" (definition: two charges for same chunk id within 15s). I'll open a small PR for the badge.
kevin: ledger change will touch quota counters and reserved capacity accounting. We should coordinate with finance and sales for any retro refunds policy.
billing-bot: note: creating ticket BILL-4921 for possible refunds and customers impacted by duplicate charges.
sam: action items: li=console flag + dashboard (48h canary), maya=proxy header + canary (24-48h), nora+kevin=ledger idempotency design + test harness (3w). I'll draft an ADR describing the dedupe set and TTL.
li: alerting idea: page when "suspected duplicate charge rate" > 0.3% of route token volume for any tenant in 10m. We want to catch regressions quickly.
ora: for ledger implementation notes: we can store recent charged chunk ids in a rocksdb per-tenant prefix with TTL entries, write path does a lookup+insert in a single write transaction to avoid races. We'll need benching to ensure write latency doesn't regress.
maya: repro steps for infra folks: quick websocat reproducer below. Works reliably if you pause client after sending a large prompt.

--- repro ---
```
# open ws, send big prompt, sleep to stall network
websocat ws://ingest.redwood/v1/stream/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -s 4096
# ctrl-z sleep 6s then resume
```

kevin: also capture a small load test that does 100 parallel clients with random stalls to validate charged_set scale.
li: deploy queued for branch `console/suspect-billing-badge` to canary-2 (eta ~ 10m).
sam: please drop any additional traces and tag them in the ADR so finance can triage refunds. will sync in tomorrow's standup.
